reason: The README describes a chat UI plugin that places provider balances, session statistics, and session-log download controls in the title bar, with host-side balance queries and browser-side display logic.

summaries.zh: 在聊天标题栏中显示 API 余额与会话统计，并提供会话日志下载功能。
summaries.en: Adds API balance and session statistics to the chat title bar and provides session log downloads.

capabilities: Reads session statistics and token usage for display
Reads configured provider credentials on the host to query supported API balance endpoints
Registers a local balance API route for the browser client
Uses a Node subprocess for outbound balance requests
Provides session log downloads through the official session export endpoint
Injects and removes plugin CSS in the document
